question: How is direction established for grasping greatness?
premises: Sun-related light before thus may be direction-establishment.
Of lord standing in middle, to grasp southern greatness.
inference: Direction-establishment is sun-related light, for grasping southern greatness of the middle lord.
plain_english: Sun-related light before thus may be direction-establishment; of the lord standing in the middle, to grasp southern greatness.
